summary: NetClass Technology, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing two unrelated share issuances. On October 28, 2026 it signed a securities purchase agreement with certain buyers for 1,590,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.20 per share, raising US$318,000 in a PIPE, funded and issued October 29. Separately it issued 1,590,000 total services shares—550,000 to Forward Sight, 540,000 to Simeon Fine, 500,000 to Layou Fortune—as compensation for development and consulting services. Board approved all issuances, structured under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S as restricted securities. No change-of-control, tender, or strategic event; routine capital-raising and share-based vendor compensation.
